result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major layout problem with truncated restaurant cards, a major issue with cut-off content at the bottom, and a minor text truncation issue.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is visually cut off on the right edge, making the card incomplete and difficult to read
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel or grid layout to ensure all cards are fully visible within the viewport, or implement proper horizontal scrolling indicators

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off at the bottom of the screen, leaving the card incomplete and unreadable
issues.suggestion: Adjust the page layout or card sizing to ensure all content is visible without cutting off cards, or implement proper scrolling within sections

issues.description: Restaurant name appears truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' (likely should be 'Trattoria Piccola'), indicating text overflow without proper handling
issues.suggestion: Implement proper text truncation with ellipsis (...) or adjust card width to accommodate full restaurant names
